title: A citation matching two works by the same authors in the same year was checked against the wrong one

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project against the live indexes

observed_failure: The draft cited (Passalis and Tefas, 2020). Two registered works matched, both were attached to the sentence, and GL reported NO_SUPPORT_QUOTE for the one the author never meant.
expected_behavior: A citation that matches more than one source is its own error (CITATION_AMBIGUOUS). The author tells the works apart with a year suffix (2020a, 2020b) recorded as year_suffix in the registry, and every tool resolves citations the same way.

resolution.summary: one resolver (lint_draft.resolve_citation) for GL, integrity and formatting; year_suffix in the source registry

lessons: Author-year citations are not unique keys; the resolver must say when it cannot choose.
